name: side-quest
description: Side Quest Learning - React frontend + Cloudflare Worker (Hono + D1)

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install --legacy-peer-deps && CI=false npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.db:migrate: node -e "console.log('Production migrations are no longer applied by deploys. After a verified backup, run: npm run db:migrate:prod (see docs/RELEASE.md).')"
scripts.test:worker: node --no-warnings --import ./worker/test/register.mjs --test worker/test/builder.test.mjs worker/test/billing.test.mjs worker/test/lifeLearning.test.mjs worker/test/portfolio.test.mjs worker/test/batches.test.mjs worker/test/outcomes.test.mjs worker/test/ac9Catalogue.test.mjs worker/test/nesaCatalogue.test.mjs worker/test/nesaImport.test.mjs worker/test/waImport.test.mjs worker/test/vicImport.test.mjs worker/test/vicSubjects.test.mjs worker/test/vic1Eal.test.mjs worker/test/autoQuest.test.mjs worker/test/plans.test.mjs worker/test/auth.test.mjs worker/test/ownerHq.test.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations list DB --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
